items.title: Microsoft November Patch Tuesday Fixes 1,235 Flaws Including Actively Exploited Outlook Zero-Day
items.summary: Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday addresses 1,235 security vulnerabilities, including one actively exploited zero-day in Outlook that steals login credentials when a malicious file is opened. The update also includes fixes for Windows, Office, and Edge. Update now via Settings > Windows Update.

items.title: Windows 11 November Update Adds Cloud Rebuild Recovery and Redesigned Right-Click Menus
items.summary: Windows 11 November update adds Cloud Rebuild recovery, redesigned right-click menus, and fixes for Remote Desktop and printing. Rollout is gradual — check Settings > Windows Update to see if it's available for your device.

items.title: Restart Once a Week to Clear Memory Leaks and Stuck Updates
items.summary: Hold your power button for 15 seconds until the screen goes black, wait a moment, then turn it back on. This clears memory leaks, stuck updates, and sluggish performance. Do it every Friday and your computer will stay snappy.

items.title: Big Security Updates Today — Microsoft, Google & Apple Released Patches
items.summary:
BIG UPDATE DAY: Microsoft, Google, and Apple released important security updates TODAY to protect your computer from real threats.

Microsoft just released patches for Windows and Office — these fix problems that could let hackers cause trouble. Google added a new scam protection to Chrome. Apple fixed issues on iPhone and Mac.

What to do: Turn on automatic updates and let them run overnight. You don't have to do anything special. Most updates install while you sleep.

Why it matters: Hackers target computers that haven't been updated. Updates close the doors they try to open.

items.title: Microsoft Released Security Updates for Windows and Office Today — Here's What Changed for You
items.summary: Microsoft released its monthly security updates for Windows 11, Windows 10, Office, and Edge today. These updates fix problems that could let hackers cause trouble. Let the update run overnight and restart when asked.

items.title: Firefox 160 Adds On-Device Speech Recognition in 40 Languages — Free Update at firefox.com
items.summary: Firefox 160 was released November 10 2026 and includes on-device speech recognition using the Web Speech API for real-time speech-to-text conversion in 40 languages. Works on desktop offline with no cloud processing. Update free at firefox.com or open Settings > About Firefox to check for updates.

items.title: Chrome 157 Security Update Fixes 213 Bugs Including 7 Critical — Update at chrome://settings/help
items.summary: Chrome 157 patches 213 security holes including seven critical flaws in graphics, memory handling, and browser features. Update now at chrome://settings/help — it takes two minutes and protects against memory corruption and graphics exploits.

items.title: Thunderbird Puts Every Email Account in One Free App — No Subscription at thunderbird.net
items.summary: Thunderbird manages Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, and custom accounts in one unified inbox. Free, open-source, no subscription at thunderbird.net — works on Windows, Mac, and Linux.

items.title: DaVinci Resolve Free Edits 4K Video with No Watermark — Download at blackmagicdesign.com
items.summary: DaVinci Resolve Free includes professional editing, color grading, VFX, and audio up to 4K 60fps. No watermark, no subscription, no time limit. Download at blackmagicdesign.com.

items.title: Microsoft PowerToys Gives You 25+ Free Windows Power Tools — Install from Microsoft Store
items.summary: PowerToys adds bulk file rename, keyboard remapping, always-on-top window, color picker, image resizer, and 20+ utilities to Windows. Free at Microsoft Store or github.com/microsoft/PowerToys — one install, all tools.
